name: IQM Quantum Computers Oyj
summary: IQM Quantum Computers Oyj builds and delivers quantum computers. The company offers full-stack quantum computing systems, including the IQM Spark system, a five-qubit quantum computer designed primarily for education and research environments; IQM Radiance system, a system currently spanning configurations from approximately 20 to 150 qubits designed for high-performance computing centers and offers an upgradeable platform; and IQM Halocene system, a system designed to scale beyond 150 qubits while incorporating quantum error correction capabilities that are intended to support more advanced quantum applications; as well as the IQM Resonance cloud platform.
